description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notice of Summon  Meeting of Under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. No. 22 of 2012 Post of Chairman of the Ninthavur P.S
categorisation: The gazette content is a notice summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Chairman in a local authority (Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha). This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, specifically addressing the procedure to elect a candidate to a vacant elected office as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It does not involve central government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) but is a specialized administrative matter related to elections, making it Type 7 (Elections).
